note: What all three seat gates answer. HTTP 402. Built from context.json and handoff-claims.json: paymentUrl is <paymentUrl>/checkout#token=<jwt>&seats=<n>, the token signed HS256 with entitlementsApiKey and seats the count the purchase has to cover: everybody seated now plus the one being invited. Where PAYMENT_URL is unset the paymentUrl key is absent and the other two are unchanged.
